title: Semantic Terminal Command Classification
description: Make sure all common terminal commands (grep, ls, sed, etc.) are semantically correctly identified as searching, editing, etc. across all native agent hook formats. Add comprehensive tests.
summary: Added classifyCommandKind function that semantically classifies 80+ shell commands (grep, ls, sed, cat, etc.) into ToolKindCodeSearch, ToolKindCodeEdit, or ToolKindTerminal. Modified ResolveHookEvent to reclassify terminal/generic tool invocations based on the actual command content. Updated Cursor beforeShellExecution/afterShellExecution to support kind-based reclassification. Added TestClassifyCommandKind with 120+ test cases covering every command. Added TestResolveHookEventCommandReclassification testing every command in every client format (claude-code, copilot-chat, droid, codex, antigravity-chat, windsurf-chat, cursor-chat preToolUse, cursor-chat beforeShellExecution) for pre/post events - totaling 672 test combinations.
